title: CORE-6993 · SHARED: customer-quote card crops the poster tighter than live
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6993](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6993)

## Verified 2026-08-25 — reproduces on 8 pages

The customer-quote video card. Live builds the poster as a **1:1 aspect box**
(`<div style="width:100%;padding-bottom:100%">`) with `object-position: center`. The clone
hardcoded `h-[300px] w-[325px]` and `object-top`, so the same photo is scaled up to cover a
325x300 box and anchored to the top — visibly tighter, with the bottom cut off.

| viewport | live | clone (before) |
|---|---|---|
| 1800 / 1440 / 1200 / 768 / 360 | 323x323 · `50% 50%` | 323x298 · `50% 0%` |

Live is a fixed square at every breakpoint, not fluid — measured headed on both.

## Scope: shared, 8 pages

`/`, `/all-inclusive-package`, `/privacy-package`, `/basic-package`, `/compare-packages`,
`/non-residents`, `/llp`, `/guarantee`.

Cross-checked on `/all-inclusive-package` (a different, non-square photo, 750x642):
323x298 · `50% 0%` before, 323x323 · `50% 50%` after — matching live's 323x323 there too.

## After

| viewport | after |
|---|---|
| 1800 / 1440 / 1200 / 768 / 360 | **323x323 · `50% 50%`** — exact match with live |

![before/after](https://60cfqkpecvp2z01z.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/pr-screenshots/core-6993/quote-card-before-after.png)

**BEFORE** = `rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app` (`main`) · **AFTER** = local production build of this branch.

> The Vercel preview could not be used: it is SSO-walled and returns `<title>Login – Vercel</title>` with **HTTP 200**, so an automated screenshot of it captures a login page rather than the app.

## What this does NOT fix — the asset itself

Look at the three panels: AFTER is square and uncropped, but still framed tighter than LIVE.
That part is not CSS. The uploaded media differs:

| | live | clone |
|---|---|---|
| source | `ed13f342-….webp` **400x400** | `john-warbuton.webp` **300x300** |

The clone's file is a tighter crop of the same photograph, and at 300px it is also **smaller
than the 323px box it renders into** (upscaled). No stylesheet change can recover live's
framing — the media needs re-uploading from the original. Filing that separately; the
undersized-source half likely belongs with CORE-6965's image-resolution class.

This PR is the geometry half: the card is now square and centred, which is correct
independently of which file sits in it.

## Checks

- `bun run ts` clean · `bun run build` green
- verified at 1800 / 1440 / 1200 / 768 / 360 on `/` and on `/all-inclusive-package`
acceptanceCriteria: The quote card is a 325px square at every breakpoint, matching live (323x323 inside the transparent border).
object-position is centre, not top — matching live.
Verified on / and on a package page at 1800 / 1440 / 1200 / 768 / 360.
Asset mismatch (clone poster is 300x300 and a tighter crop; live is 400x400) recorded as a separate CMS follow-up, NOT fixed here.
